description: A recent run was slow, but the Conditions section shows it was hot (heat-adjusted pace much faster than actual). The Read MUST use the conditions to explain the slow pace as heat, NOT read it as lost fitness or a fitness decline. It should reference the heat/temperature/conditions; it must NOT claim fitness dropped or the athlete is slowing down / losing form based on that run.
